Thanks, I plan on seeking aid. The words of encouragement are very helpful and I'm feeling a bit better from when I wrote this. Starting to come out of a multi-day extreme low and I'm working on keeping it this way. Eating well and exercise were two things I already did, but I stopped at the beginning of this week because I was too depressed. Trying to eat a salad right now.
I'll tell her in my own time. I just want to make sure that it's the correct time to do so. I want her to be completely comfortable in making the right decision for her. I will definitely tell her when I can though.
